title: Umphefumulo Ongemuva Kwesithombe
intro: Ethunzini lokuphuma okukhulu ebudloveni, lesi sibalo esiyimfihlakalo sasilinde ehlane. Ngesikhathi umholi wesizwe esikhethiwe ekhuphuka intaba engcwele ukuze athole ubudlelwano obungcwele, kwavela isivivinyo esikhulu kulabo abasele ngemuva. Lo muntu wathatha lesi sikhathi ukuze ashintshe izinkolelo zomphakathi wonke. Lapho umholi ebuya neqiniso, kwanqunywa isijeziso esiyingqayizivele nesiphakade. Ungakwazi yini ukuthola ukuthi lo mphefumulo ophikisanayo nonobuqili wawungubani?
clues: Ngahamba nabantu ababekhululwe ezandleni zomcindezeli onamandla ngezibonakaliso ezimangalisayo.
Lapho umholi wabo ekhuphukela entabeni ukuyothola isiqondiso, ngalinda phakathi kwalabo abasala ngemuva.
Ngaqoqa insimbi eyigugu emihlobiso yabo ngayibumba yaba yinto ekhiqiza umsindo.
Ngale ndalo, ngaqinisekisa isizukulwane sonke ukuthi base bethole unkulunkulu wabo ehlane.
Lapho umholi ebuya, ngakhethwa futhi ngabuzwa ukuthi yini eyangiholela ekukhohliseni okunjalo.
Isijeziso sami kuleli zwe kwakuwukuthi akekho owayengithinta noma asondele, uphawu lwehlazo engiluthwele kuze kube phakade.

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
